title: the artifact-scope exclusion strands the article's own headline example on the user path
note: Two frozen scenarios pull apart on the C2 (user) path. 'a unit bound to the target the user intended is diagnosed as drift' routes ANY drift-diagnosing reader to the arrangements unconditionally, while the repaired 'the four arrangements are ranked by separation strength' requires the article to declare those arrangements scoped to a produced-artifact instruction. A reader whose drifting instruction governs User or Agent is therefore pointed at a chooser that declares itself out of scope for them. This was adjudicated at README:155-164 as an exclusion rather than a hole and ratified at the spec gate, so it is not a Conflict — but the repair made the exclusion reader-visible for the first time, and a BLIND reader hit it as the single largest obstacle in the document, resolving it only by transposing arrangement 1 themselves from an isolation paragraph in another section rather than using the chooser. The stranded case is the article's own running example: article-writer-voice (Artifact) bleeding into replies (User), the pair the article names to sell itself and the README names as the C2 trigger. The architect's justification (drift runs toward the most-served target, so the drowned instruction is the artifact's) is sound for the author path A3; it is the user path V1 -> P where a reader arrives with the mirror case. Worth re-examining at the spec.
